colFeeBorrowerExitOps().return: ops Pinned borrower-exit charge hook (address(0) until pinned).

isOwner().details: Returns true if the caller is the current owner.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

setColFeeBorrowerExitOps(address).notice: Pin/rotate the borrower-exit charge hook. Reverts on a         non-contract so disabling charging is a deliberate act.

setExitFeeController(address).notice: Pin/rotate the ExitFeeController. Reverts on a non-contract so a         typo can't point the quote staticcall at a no-code address.

userdoc.notice: Owner-gated admin for the two ColFee protocol pointers on the        sovrynProtocol proxy: the ExitFeeController and the borrower-exit        charge hook (`ColFeeBorrowerExitOps`).
